name: api
description: App Builder API, an LLM generates HTTP-handler apps, stores them, and serves each live

scripts.build: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -i build/${LLM_PROVIDER:-anthropic}/bundle.js --initLocation http://api.localhost -o dist/api-${LLM_PROVIDER:-anthropic}.wasm
scripts.build:debug: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -d -i build/${LLM_PROVIDER:-anthropic}/bundle.js --initLocation http://api.localhost -o dist/api-${LLM_PROVIDER:-anthropic}.wasm
